ConnectionStrings._comment: Real SQL Server, deliberately not committed here. Supply via: dotnet user-secrets --project QuotesPlatform.Host set "ConnectionStrings:Default" "<value>"

ServiceBus._comment: The dev namespace's fully-qualified name (e.g. sb-quotes-dev.servicebus.windows.net). Authenticated with DefaultAzureCredential, no key. Supply via: dotnet user-secrets --project QuotesPlatform.Host set "ServiceBus:FullyQualifiedNamespace" "<value>"

LogLevel._comment_efcore: EF Core logs every command at Information. Four outbox relays polling on a short interval means four full SELECTs per tick in the console, which drowns the lines that matter -- relay published, consumer handled, endpoint failed. Warning here keeps failures and hides the heartbeat. Raise it to Information deliberately when you are debugging a query.
